info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Payments Status Retrieval API enables users to obtain the current status of payments within the system. This service allows financial institutions, merchants, and developers to programmatically check and monitor the progress of payment transactions. With the ability to retrieve detailed status updates, clients can ensure accurate reporting and timely responses to customers. Typical use cases include auditing payment processes, integrating payment status updates into applications, and enhancing customer service through real-time information.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a payment
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of a specified payment. You'll receive detailed information about the payment's progress and whether it has been completed, is pending, or has failed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payment status. Ensure that you provide the correct payment identifiers to receive accurate status information.
